definition.description: Searches for a group in Microsoft Graph API by its display name using OData filtering. Returns the group profile including ID, membership settings, security configuration, and sync status. Handles exact name matching and gracefully reports when no group is found.

inputFields.helpText: Microsoft Graph OAuth access token with Group.Read.All or Directory.Read.All permissions. Obtain via OAuth 2.0 flow or use the Connector Token node.
The exact display name of the group to search for. Uses OData $filter with 'eq' operator for exact matching. Supports placeholders for dynamic lookups.
Comma-separated list of group properties to return (e.g., id,displayName,description,securityEnabled). Reduces response payload. Leave empty to return all default properties.

outputParameters.description: The complete group object containing all requested properties from Microsoft Graph. Returns the first match if multiple groups have the same name.
Serialized JSON string of the group object, ready for storage or transmission to external systems
Boolean indicating whether a group with the specified name was found in the directory
Number of groups matching the display name. Typically 1, but may be higher if multiple groups share the same name.
The group's unique Azure AD object ID (GUID). Empty string if group not found.
The group's display name as shown in the directory. Empty string if group not found.
The group's mail nickname/alias. Empty string if group not found.
Boolean indicating if this is a security group (can be used for access control). False if group not found.
Boolean indicating if this is a mail-enabled group (distribution list or Microsoft 365 group). False if group not found.
Boolean flag indicating if an API error or exception occurred during the request
Detailed error message including HTTP status code and exception details if applicable

connectionTags.description: Triggered when one or more groups matching the display name were found
Triggered when no group with the specified display name exists in the directory
Triggered when an API error, authentication failure, or exception occurs during the request
